verdict.rationale: Docusaurus builds pure static HTML/JS via `npm run build` into a `build` directory that can be hosted anywhere (docs-13, docs-22), confirmed by a hands-on scaffold probe showing a self-contained, vendor-agnostic site with no lock-in (docusaurus-probe-rt-1). Community accounts corroborate active real-world use and portability (comm-8, comm-20), though some report performance/build-time concerns unrelated to portability itself. Missing for 10: no independent third-party audit of hosting portability across multiple providers beyond docs and one probe.
